The SVG path uses two arc commands with the same radii (15.26,15.26), large-arc-flag 1, and sweep-flag 0, starting and ending at the same point (92.14,43.42) via an intermediate point (72.48,66.76). Each arc sweeps 310.12 degrees, so together they form a full ellipse (since 310.12° + 310.12° = 620.24°, which is 260.24° more than 360°, meaning the arcs overlap). The equal radii in both x and y directions mean it’s a circle, not an ellipse.

Final answer: (A)
